chunks: 4225 - And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Burd, he said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “May I be your ransom, we work with pig hair, and sometimes a man forgets and prays while there is something of it in his hand.”

So he said: “He should not pray while there is something of it in his hand.” And he said: “Take it and wash it. Whatever has grease on it, do not use it; and whatever does not have grease on it, then use it, and wash your hands from it.”

key_terms.دَسَمٌ: grease or fatty residue remaining on the hair
key_terms.شَعْرِ الْخِنْزِيرِ: pig hair used in work or handling
key_terms.فَاعْمَلُوا بِهِ: use it when the stated condition is met
key_terms.فَلَا تَعْمَلُوا بِهِ: do not use it in that state
key_terms.وَاغْسِلُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ: wash your hands after handling it

ai.seo_question: Can someone pray while holding pig hair, and is pig hair permissible to use after washing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about using pig hair and its effect on salat (prayer). It states that one should not pray while holding something made from it, and that such hair may be washed and used only if it is free from grease, with the hands to be washed afterward.
